title: Twice Dark summons the shadows with addictive new single, "Necromantic"
htmlContent: Twice Dark, a band known for their unique blend of industrial and gothic sounds, has just released their fourth single, "Necromantic." This new song offers a haunting yet captivating experience, inviting listeners into a mysterious world where love, loss, and the supernatural meet. "Necromantic" feels like a movie taking you on a journey into the darkness. It tells the story of a man who encounters a ghost in a graveyard at midnight. With its powerful beats and a somber mood, the song pulls you in, touching on themes of grief and longing. It is a comforting song for those who find peace in the shadows. The song is made even more striking by a special guest appearance from Scott Harris of Hororhaus, whose haunting vocals blend perfectly with Twice Dark's deep and moody style. His contribution adds depth to the song, enhancing its loss and unfinished business themes. Recorded at Postal Recording in Indianapolis, "Necromantic" showcases a mix of lively beats that you could dance to while still carrying an emotional weight. https://open.spotify.com/album/4QPOkG1ZBfVo0rVmKGy8mN The production captures the music's fierce energy and eerie beauty, creating a vibrant yet reflective track. As fans eagerly await the release of their upcoming album, Telekinetic, "Necromantic" offers an exciting glimpse of what lies ahead. Twice Dark is crafting songs that resonate deeply within our souls. Get ready to step into the night, "Necromantic" is here to lead you on this enchanting journey.
